Title: General availability: Azure Cosmos DB portal—Azure Synapse Link seamless Power BI

Body.Content:
Visualize your Azure Cosmos DB data in near real time seamlessly using the integrated Power BI experience in the Azure Cosmos DB portal. Azure Synapse Link allows you to build Power BI reports and dashboards with no performance or cost impact to your transactional workloads or ETL pipelines. Use DirectQuery with Power BI to query live data from your Azure Cosmos DB accounts without importing or copying the data into Power BI.

Learn more.
